learned_findings.observed: Writing a custom agents.<id> entry without 'default_channel': 'console' (matching README.md lines 192-199) leaves AgentProfileConfig.default_channel='' and raises RuntimeError('inbound authenticity denied (reason=invalid_channel, mode=warn)').
learned_findings.recommendation: Default Agent._build_payload or AgentProfileConfig.default_channel to 'console' for embedded Python SDK calls so minimal agents.json profiles run out of the box.
learned_findings.title: Minimal agents.<id> block omits default_channel and fails inbound authenticity in warn mode

learned_findings.observed: Configuring 'agents': {'gemini-live': {'name': 'Gemini Live', ...}} causes runtime profile lookup during timeout calculation to pass display name 'Gemini Live' instead of key 'gemini-live', raising UnknownProfileError.
learned_findings.recommendation: Separate immutable profile_id (dict key) from human display_name in AgentProfileConfig and resolve_runtime_profile.
learned_findings.title: Setting human display string in agents.<id>.name triggers UnknownProfileError

learned_findings.observed: Calling second = agent.run(...) on the same Agent(session_id='shared') without thread_id=first.thread_id sets thread_decision_action='fork_thread' (settled_without_resume) and session_history_available='false', hiding prior turn messages until thread_id is supplied.
learned_findings.recommendation: Either auto-carry last_thread_id inside stateful Agent instances when session_id matches, or update examples/sdk/sessions.py to pass thread_id=first.thread_id explicitly.
learned_findings.title: Sequential Agent.run calls on one session_id fork threads unless thread_id is passed

learned_findings.observed: CLI setup lists 20 catalog IDs ('gemini', 'cortensor-portal', 'cortensor-router'), while SUPPORTED_PROVIDERS in agents.json only accepts 9 transport keys ('openai', 'cortensor', etc.). Cortensor Portal uses 'openai' with max_retries=0 (cortensor_portal_no_idempotency).
learned_findings.recommendation: Accept catalog aliases in OpenMinionConfig.from_dict and normalize them to transport + base_url overrides automatically, or surface the canonical agents.json snippet in setup --list-providers --json.
learned_findings.title: Setup catalog provider IDs differ from agents.json SUPPORTED_PROVIDERS keys

learned_findings.observed: Telemetry metadata ('llm_call_counts_by_purpose') records 7 LLM calls (entry=1, freshness_classify=1, act=3, reflect=1, judge=1; ~16.4k input tokens) for 1 tool call, multiplying decentralized Cortensor router latency ~7x.
learned_findings.recommendation: Add a 'fast_single_pass' profile skipping post-turn reflect/judge/freshness calls on bounded SDK tool workflows, and switch OllamaProviderConfig.tool_call_strategy default to 'hybrid'.
learned_findings.title: Single tool turn triggers 7 internal LLM calls and Ollama defaults to fallback tool parsing
